verdict.rationale: Carta is an equity-management SaaS with an API, and a buyer could reasonably ask whether its workflows can be versioned and rolled back, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Promoting a playground app to production and creating draft option grants are related but different features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
